svg.title: System architecture: deployable units and the data they exchange
svg.desc: Web is the public HTTP edge. Internal gRPC serves identity, listings, search, carts, stock reads, orders and checkout. Debezium streams MongoDB and PostgreSQL outboxes to Kafka. Independent catalog consumers populate Meilisearch and seed inventory. Checkout publishes one preparation command consumed by Orders and Inventory in separate groups (three replicas each in production), then joins their versioned results, calls the external gateway, and verifies signed outcomes forwarded by Web.
